audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart read Qiyana on all seven rows; content and packet read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei.
audit.why: Qiyana's Q reaches 525 and Audacity 650, so a Hwei painting from outside both owns levels 1-3; 4-5 and 6 are contested once Audacity is 8-9s and Supreme Display of Talent exists; item burst re-takes it.
audit.corrected: Sides moved to match the packet and content chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike is attributed to 'Royal Privilege', which is Qiyana's PASSIVE (bonus damage on her first attack or ability against each enemy). Her ultimate is Supreme Display of Talent.
audit.why: Riot's passive text is one line about first-hit bonus damage. The 950-range shockwave that detonates elements and stuns is the R, on a flat 120s.
audit.corrected: whys[3], spikes[1].text and mid re-pointed to Supreme Display of Talent with its 120s cooldown and 950 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page's core claim was 'once Audacity is spent she cannot reach you'. That is false: Terrashape (W) is a 1100-range dash on a flat 7 seconds.
audit.why: Riot's W text: Qiyana dashes to a location and enchants her weapon with an element. It is her repositioning tool AND her damage enabler, and 7s is shorter than every Hwei paint cooldown except QQ at rank 5. Kiting 'the Audacity cooldown' therefore does not make you safe.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and tradeBad now state both dashes and their real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer is full of invented HWEI ability names: 'Devastating Fire Painting (E)', 'Severance (W)', 'Death Fire Grasp (Q fire form)', 'Life Trade (ultimate)', 'Living Nightmare'. None of these are Hwei abilities.
audit.why: Hwei's real subspells are Devastating Fire / Severing Bolt / Molten Fissure (Q), Fleeting Current / Pool of Reflection / Stirring Lights (W), and Grim Visage / Gaze of the Abyss / Crushing Maw (E). Devastating Fire is a Q subspell, not an E, and nothing in his kit is called Severance, Death Fire Grasp, Life Trade or Living Nightmare.
audit.corrected: All five fabrications removed. Where I could not be certain which E subspell the page's 'EE fear' label maps to, I wrote the slot label the rest of the page already uses rather than assert a name.

audit.whatIsWrong: 23 misgender hits, two COPY_PASTE_BLEED bullets, breakdown.cooldowns with no digit, and a 'fifteen-second invitation' that matches no Qiyana cooldown.
audit.why: Qiyana is female per champ-gender.js. Audacity is 11/10/9/8/7, not fifteen.

Just don't get caught out of position when she flashes W onto you.

Chart: full layer read Qiyana on all seven rows; content win[N] and packet.levelChart both read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei. Full-layer sides moved to match as one atomic group. No paired win[N] edits are included because win[N] is already correct on disk.

Five fabricated HWEI ability names were in this matchup's content layer and are now gone: 'Devastating Fire Painting (E)', 'Severance (W)', 'Death Fire Grasp (Q fire form)', 'Life Trade (ultimate)', 'Living Nightmare'. This is the worst fabrication density I saw across my eight matchups — it is worth grepping hwei.js for these five strings in other matchups too, since they read like a shared template.

'Royal Privilege' was used as her ultimate/engage in three places. It is her passive; the ultimate is Supreme Display of Talent.

The page's claim 'once Audacity is spent she cannot reach you' was false — Terrashape is a 1100-range dash on a flat 7s. That is a safety-relevant error and I corrected it everywhere in scope.
